source: BEA Supply-Use summary tables 2017 + project tariff schedule
known_limitations: Each 10-digit commodity line carries exactly one NAICS industry in the official concordance, so no within-line weighting assumption is made. Aggregation loss remains only where Census itself writes an 'X' in a NAICS code to hide undisclosed detail, and where a line's NAICS falls outside the BEA summary manufacturing and primary groups. 172 codes carry a different NAICS in a later vintage; the pre-treatment assignment governs, and that count bounds how much the choice matters.
Direct requirements are normalised by the intermediate-input column total, not by total industry output including value added, so shares are input shares of intermediate purchases.
